title: Lifting a fixed abelian inverse-image section on a descended object
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition maps, and $(X,\pi)$ a limit cone [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Write $B_q$ for base change on the small étale category, $q^*$ for inverse image on abelian sheaves, and $\eta_{q,H}(T):H(T)\to(q^*H)(B_qT)$ for its evaluated unit [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Fix $i_0\in I$ and a quasi-compact quasi-separated étale object $T_0$ over $D_{i_0}$. For $J=\{j\in I\mid i_0\le j\}$ put $T_j=B_{p_{ji_0}}T_0$ and $T_X=B_{\pi_{i_0}}T_0$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose given isomorphisms $\gamma_a:B_{p_{kj}}T_j\simeq T_k$ and $\delta_j:B_{\pi_j}T_j\simeq T_X$, whose first projections to $T_0$ equal the corresponding iterated first projections (and whose base projections agree because these are arrows over the base). Fix $i\in J$, one abelian sheaf $H$ on $D_i$, and $y\in(\pi_i^*H)(B_{\pi_i}T_i)$. Then there are $k\in J$, $a:i\to k$, and $s\in(p_{ki}^*H)(B_{p_{ki}}T_i)$ such that
$$
(\pi_i^*H)(\beta_a)\bigl(\chi_{a,H}^{-1}(B_{\pi_k}B_{p_{ki}}T_i)(\eta_{\pi_k,p_{ki}^*H}(B_{p_{ki}}T_i)(s))\bigr)=y.
$$
Here $\chi_{a,H}:\pi_i^*H\simeq\pi_k^*p_{ki}^*H$ is the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphism, and $\beta_a= B_{\pi_k}(\gamma_a^{-1})\circ\delta_k^{-1}\circ\delta_i:B_{\pi_i}T_i\to B_{\pi_k}B_{p_{ki}}T_i$. The notation $(\pi_i^*H)(\beta_a)$ denotes contravariant restriction along $\beta_a$. Only one coefficient sheaf occurs; there is no varying system of coefficient sheaves or colimit cocone of such sheaves.

source.place: Sites Tags 09YM (inverse-image section formula), 09YN (lemma-colimit, inner colimit); Étale Cohomology Tag 09YQ, degree-zero affine-site realization.

proof.text: Restrict to the upper tail of i, which is directed and cofinal. Base change T_i to this tail. Affine projections preserve its qcqs property. The full affine étale site of the limit is the colimit of the full affine stage sites.

Use the full affine étale topos comparison. For the single sheaf H, the inverse-image section formula on the colimit site gives a filtered colimit of sections of p_ki^*H on B_pki T_i. Its coprojections are the units for pi_k followed by the inverse-image composition comparison. Therefore an affine limit section has a stage representative. The first-projection hypotheses identify beta with the pullback-pasting comparison by uniqueness of arrows of pullbacks.

For qcqs T_i use a finite affine cover and finite affine covers of the pairwise intersections. Represent each cover restriction at a stage. The equality criterion for the same filtered section colimits makes the finitely many overlap equalities hold at one later stage. The stage sheaf condition glues the matching family; separatedness identifies its limit image with y. Equivalently, the finite-cover section-colimit theorem commutes these finite matching equalizers with the filtered colimit. Empty covers produce zero sections.

proof_origin.place: Fixed-coefficient inner colimit in 09YN, with finite affine-cover descent; extracted from the scalar representative proof.

lean.statement:
theorem fixed_abelian_descended_section_lift
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (i₀ : I) (T₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    [CompactSpace T₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T₀.left] :
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let Tj := fun j : J ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
        (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)).obj T₀
    let Tlim := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj T₀
    ∀ (γ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tj k)
      (δ : ∀ j : J,
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tlim),
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (γ j k a).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE k.property).op) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
      (∀ j : J,
        (δ j).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (c.π.app (op i₀)) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (c.π.app (op j.val)) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
    ∀ (i : J) (H : Sheaf (D.obj (op i.val)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (y : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i.val))).obj H).obj.obj
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (c.π.app (op i.val))).obj (Tj i)))),
      ∃ (k : J) (a : i ⟶ k)
        (s : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (D.map (show i.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj H).obj.obj
            (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
              (D.map (show i.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj i)))),
        (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (c.π.app (op k.val))).unit.app
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (D.map (show i.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj H)).hom.app
                (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                  (D.map (show i.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj i))) ≫
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op k.val))
            (D.map (show i.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) (c.π.app (op i.val))
              (c.w (show i.val ⟶ k.val from a).op).symm).inv.app H).hom.app
                (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                  (c.π.app (op k.val))).obj
                    ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                      (D.map (show i.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj i)))) ≫
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i.val))).obj H).obj.map
            ((δ i).hom ≫ (δ k).inv ≫
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op k.val))).map
                (γ i k a).inv).op) s = y
